train: 8526 original train examples except all reserved localizers; supervision only in training
development: 1504 consumed dev examples; adaptive engineering, no independent final audit claim
reservation: All reserved workers and original test remain unused
algorithm: CSR averaged perceptron. Optional Unicode character 2..4-gram features for intent/current word; optional shared lexical updates for B/I of the same role, while context/boundary updates remain distinct. New explicit codec and module, unchanged old decoders.
change_hypothesis: First four policies isolate unchanged control, role sharing, subword features and their combination. Reuse learned role evidence across a multiword span and morphological fragments without hardcoded Portuguese vocabulary. Exact scores and full error counts decide, not a promise of improvement.
selection: Exact complete dev structures, then fewer retained weights, then policy order
metrics: Every intent and ordered role/value must match; all mistakes and abstentions counted, including weak families and novelty strata
completion_contract: evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json; every required gate unchanged before M1 or M2
scope: Known feature engineering and parameter sharing, not a novel AGI claim or autonomous evolution. Same 196608-byte page and 262144-byte genome/residency caps. No pretrained language model, no test labels at prediction, no effects, unknown RSS/energy remain unavailable.
